title: The most dominant athlete of the 2010s was a horse
description:
Frankel ran 14 races between 2010 and 2012 and won all 14. Bookmakers priced him at 1/20 - the betting market gave up pretending he could lose. Timeform's rating scale had a 50-year ceiling of 145; Frankel was rated 147, the highest in the history of ratings.
Bonus story: his trainer, Sir Henry Cecil, trained Frankel's entire career while dying of cancer, and said one of the wins made him feel twenty years better. He passed away months after the horse retired - fourteen perfect races as a farewell.
